originality.rationale: The defining upper-parameter full text and the primary complete-multipartite k-tuple/total-domination literature were compared at statement level. The former contains the minimality witness but no multipartite result; the latter concerns minimum parameters and/or open neighborhoods, which do not imply the maximum-cardinality minimal closed-neighborhood theorem. semantic-literature database and web searches under upper k-tuple, upper double, minimal k-tuple, multipartite, and multiple-domination aliases did not locate a stronger or equivalent arbitrary-complete-multipartite statement. value.rationale: Upper k-tuple domination is an established hard domination invariant. Complete multipartite graphs are a canonical structured family already central to minimum k-tuple and total-domination work. An exact formula across every feasible k, with an explicit extremal construction, supplies a reusable benchmark and cleanly separates maximum-minimal closed-neighborhood behavior from the prior minimum/total results.
